linkedin:
The household chore most robot vacuums still leave to you is the mop.

The SwitchBot S20 handles that part too: it washes and dries its own mop and refills and drains its water automatically, with 10,000Pa suction and LiDAR + AI camera navigation.

It lists at $799.99, so it's a premium pick for people who would rather spend money than weekend hours. This is a specs-based pick, not a hands-on test. Full breakdown in the first comment.
